title: Settings & Configuration

privacy.title: Galactic and Astral Dimensions
privacy.desc: Choose which aspects of your human design, astrology and manual are visible to the community.
privacy.contactDesc: Configure which direct contact details are displayed on your public passport.
privacy.archetypeDesc: Shows your personality archetype, strengths, shadows and suggested sociocratic role.
privacy.hdDesc: Shows your human design type, authority and profile.
privacy.kinDesc: Shows your Mayan Kin, galactic seal and Mayan community role.
privacy.astroDesc: Shows your Sun, Moon, Ascendant and dominant elements.
privacy.manualDesc: Shows the autogenerated coexistence manual with your 5 sections.
privacy.instagramDesc: Shows your Instagram handle and direct link to your profile.
privacy.linkedinDesc: Shows your LinkedIn professional profile on the passport.
privacy.telegramDesc: Shows your Telegram handle or link for direct messaging.
privacy.websiteDesc: Direct link to your personal website or project.
privacy.phoneDesc: Shows native call and direct WhatsApp buttons.
privacy.emailDesc: Shows your public email address for community contact.
